about_the_game:
Line Defense is a fast-paced action-strategy game where every second counts. Enemies surge onto the battlefield in relentless waves, and it’s up to you to react, adapt, and outmaneuver them with split-second decision-making. Instead of setting static defenses and waiting, you’re constantly on the move—dodging attacks, firing abilities, redirecting threats, and using tactical tools to maintain control of the chaos.

Build and customize powerful loadouts, master unique character abilities, and push your reflexes to their limits as you fight to keep your line from collapsing. Every run demands sharp strategy, fast reaction time, and precise execution.

If you love high-energy combat, tight skill expression, and strategic depth, Line Defense delivers a nonstop challenge.

Key Features:

• High-Speed Action Strategy
React instantly to shifting battlefield threats. Dodge, unleash abilities, reposition, and outplay enemies in real time.

• Deep Build Customization
Choose characters, upgrade abilities, and craft powerful synergies to adapt your playstyle and dominate incoming waves.

• Skill-Based Combat
Success isn’t passive—your movement, timing, and aim determine whether you survive the onslaught.

• Dynamic Enemy Waves
Face a constantly evolving mix of enemy types that force you to adjust your tactics on the fly.

• Progression & Replayability
Unlock upgrades, refine your strategy, and push toward higher difficulties that demand flawless execution.

• Stylish Visuals & Explosive Effects
Experience crisp, energetic action with vibrant effects and responsive feedback that make every moment feel intense.

Line Defense is easy to pick up, hard to master, and built for players who crave fast, frictionless action backed by meaningful strategic choices.
